svg.title: Osmosis through a semipermeable membrane
svg.desc: (a) Two sugar-water solutions, separated by a semipermeable membrane that passes water (small blue dots) but not sugar (larger red dots). The right side has more sugar, so its water is less concentrated, and water moves by osmosis to the right. (b) The right-hand level rises until the back pressure hρg from the height difference h balances the osmotic flow. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Equal mean water exchange; zero net flow
Water crosses both ways; solute stays blocked. Height difference grows until ρgΔh balances osmotic
